messages:
sasha: quick sync — follow-ups from Friday's GPU saturation postmortem. we still have ~5 open action items that need concrete owners and timelines. who can take quota / scheduler / headroom bits?

jordana: I can grab quota buffer & tenant throttling. planning doc?

sasha: awesome. goal is a concrete PR + runbook patch in 2 weeks. note: we want a short-term band-aid before the longer scheduler tuning.

wei: I'll take scheduler tuning (packing window + preemption thresholds). I'll propose parameter values after running the replay. ETA: 3 working days for measurement, 10 business days for PR.

andrew: I can do the headroom planning and burst reserve proposals. idea: reserve a small pool (5% of capacity) for transient spikes and auto-drawdown on sustained load. will draft numbers by Tue.

mira: I'll own the postmortem follow-through checklist: update the runbook, add the weekly incident pattern query, and coordinate the customer comms. ETA: next Wednesday.

ops-bot: Incident #6123 status changed to: in-progress (owners assigned: jordana, wei, andrew, mira).

sasha: thanks. two things to be explicit about: 1) recurring pattern — spikes at ~02:00 UTC correlated with nightly model re-quant jobs. 2) quota fallback needs to avoid cascading scheduler evictions.

jordana: on the quota piece: propose adding a per-tenant "soft buffer" of 15% above committed quota for 60s bursts, then a 5-minute exponential cooldown. that should absorb short bumps without hitting the global scheduler.

wei: noted. for the scheduler, my initial numbers: packing_window_ms=50 -> 75, eviction_threshold_pct=92 -> 94, preempt_grace_ms=300 -> 500. these reduce premature evictions at the expense of tiny latency jitter. will validate with traffic replay.

andrew: headroom math: using current utilization curves, 5% reserved + a 10% temporary surge cap (drained over 10 min) reduces incident probability by ~70% in our sim. i'll attach the sim snapshot to the ticket.

mira: runbook updates: add an automated query that surfaces the 02:00 UTC pattern (avg GPU util per tenant, pending queues). also add a checklist to escalate if headroom dips below 8% for >3 intervals.

jordana: ops checklist item: add an automated throttle escalation that notifies owners and falls back to lower-capacity model (smaller context / quantized) if tenant breach persists >2 min. who owns the fallback model routing?

wei: I can wire the scheduler hook to call the routing service. we need a small API patch in the model-router to accept a "degraded-mode" flag. I'll scope it in the PR.

andrew: cross-check: can we avoid tenant-level SLA surprises? add telemetry that records every fallback event to the tenant usage log + billing annotations. i'll add that to my headroom PR.

mira: I'll add a doc note to notify affected tenant-owners when fallback occurred and provide a link to the event ID.

ops-bot: New GitHub issue created: redwood/infra#1549 - "quota-soft-buffer + fallback routing" (assignee: jordana).

sasha: decision log: short term (1–2 weeks) = quota soft buffer (jordana), scheduler parameter tweaks (wei), headroom reserve proposal (andrew), runbook + telemetry updates (mira). medium term (3–6 weeks) = scheduler PR and automated fallback routing patch.

jordana: action items with deadlines: 1) proposal doc + PR for quota buffer — due 2026-04-06; 2) add throttle escalation to runbook — due 2026-04-01.

wei: measurement plan: run two replays (baseline + with packing_window 75ms) and compare eviction rate and p99 latency. I'll paste logs in the ticket. target: <10% increase in p99, >30% reduction in evictions. due 2026-03-27.

andrew: headroom PR draft by 2026-03-31. will include sim csv and cost delta.

mira: runbook + telemetry changes PR by 2026-04-01. I'll add the incident query SQL and an example notification template.

sasha: good. also want a recurring follow-up: weekly 15-min triage for next 6 weeks to watch for reoccurrence. rotate ownership between infra oncall.

jordana: added to calendar: "GPU autoscale follow-up" weekly 15m starting 2026-03-24 @ 09:00 PDT. invite sent.

mira: quick note on customer comms: for any tenant that actually hit fallback we should include a short post-incident summary and a mitigation ETA. I'll draft a template.

ops-bot: Reminder: incident #6123 action item "scheduler tuning" assigned to wei is pending measurement. due 2026-03-27.

sasha: last item — we observed a recurring correlation with backup jobs launching at 01:50 UTC. can platform infra gate those jobs behind a capacity check? if yes, add it as a follow-up.

wei: yes we can. I'll add a preflight check to the job runner: if global headroom < 10% then delay job by randomized backoff 1-5m. PR scoped in the scheduler work.

andrew: also propose a nightly quota audit that flags tenants with aggressive scheduling patterns so we can proactively talk to them. i'll scope an alert.

mira: thanks everyone — will consolidate owners & deadlines into the incident ticket and ping once PRs start landing. closing loop: weekly syncs for 6 weeks, then move to monthly if stable.

sasha: perfect. closing thread for now. ping in-thread when PRs are ready or if you need a hand. :thumbsup:
